evidence.ref: .warp/status_server.py is a thin read-only local status server over stdlib http: GET /status returns the R3 runstatus.status() model as JSON (one projection, no drift), GET / is a self-contained inline-CSS/JS page that renders and refreshes it, GET /events is an SSE live stream; it binds 127.0.0.1 ONLY (never 0.0.0.0), is GET-only (other methods return the stdlib 501), reads through runstatus and writes NOTHING. The front door is warp status --serve [--port N]; the server is lazy-imported so the reader keeps no load-time dependency on it.
